subject: Love the new timeline
body: Just wanted to say the new timeline view is fantastic. Our team switched to it for sprint planning this week and it saved us an hour of meeting time. Great work!
your product is great, thanks

subject: Feedback on the redesign
body:
Hello,

I've been using your product daily for about four years, mostly for managing our agency's client projects, and I've recommended it to at least a dozen people. I'm writing because the redesign that rolled out last month has made my days noticeably harder, and I suspect I'm not the only one.

The main problems for me: the sidebar now collapses by default, so every time I open the app I have to expand it again; the project list is sorted by "recent" instead of alphabetically, so projects jump around and I click the wrong one; and the task detail panel opens as a full page instead of on the side, so I lose sight of the board.

Individually these are small, but together they add a lot of friction to something I do hundreds of times a day. I'm not asking for a refund or anything like that, and I'm not planning to leave. I just hope the product team hears from long-time users, not only from new ones.

Thanks for reading,
Claire Dubois
Founder, Studio Lumen
Your support team is amazing. Kofi solved our SSO problem in 20 minutes when I expected it to take days. Please pass on my thanks!

subject: Frustrated with support response times
body: I've submitted three tickets in the last month and each one took over 5 days to get a first reply. When the replies came, they were generic copy-paste answers that didn't address my question. I'm paying for Business and expected better. Not asking for anything specific right now, but I wanted someone to know.

subject: Survey response
body: Responding to your survey email since the form didn't load: I'd give you an 8/10. Great core product, the mobile app is the weakest part. Pricing is fair. Would recommend to others.
The app has become cluttered with features we don't use. It used to be simple and that's why we chose you. Every update adds another button. Just my two cents.

subject: Kudos on the API docs
body: Your new API documentation is the best I've seen in a long time: clear examples, a working sandbox, and honest notes about limitations. It made our integration project much easier. Thank you to whoever wrote it.

subject: Disappointed with pricing changes
body: The new pricing punishes small teams like ours. We're 4 people and our bill went up 60% because of the new minimum seat count. I understand you need to make money, but it feels like loyal small customers are being pushed out. We'll probably stay for now, but it leaves a bad taste.
meh. the notifications are too noisy and the search is bad. otherwise fine

subject: Feedback + a feature request
body: We've been using the product for a year and overall we're happy. The one recurring complaint from my team is the lack of a proper dark mode. Could you add one? Also, the onboarding checklist for new members was really well done. Keep that up.

subject: Accessibility feedback
body: I'm a screen reader user (NVDA on Windows). The board view is very hard to use: cards aren't announced properly, drag and drop has no keyboard alternative, and focus jumps to the top of the page after every action. The list view is better. I'd love to see accessibility treated as a priority. I'm happy to test things if that helps.
Honestly the best project tool we've tried, and we've tried five. Just wanted to say that. No question.

subject: Onboarding experience
body: Hi, we just onboarded our 40-person team. Some observations: the invite flow was smooth, but the first-time tutorial is way too long (people skipped it), and the default project template assumes a software team, which confused our marketing folks. Might be worth offering templates by department. Overall a positive experience.

subject: Unhappy with the latest update + refund?
body: The latest update removed the compact list view that our whole team relied on. Now everything takes twice the screen space. This is a big step backwards. If it's not coming back, I'd like to discuss a partial refund for the rest of our annual term, since the product we paid for has changed.
The new AI summaries are surprisingly good. Saved me from reading 80 comments on a task this morning. Nice job.

subject: Customer since 2018
body:
Hi all,

I've been a customer since 2018, when you were a much smaller company, and I wanted to share some honest reflections. In the early years, every piece of feedback I sent got a thoughtful personal reply, often from someone on the product team. Features I asked for sometimes appeared a few months later, and it felt like a partnership.

These days the product is more powerful, but it also feels more generic, and my feedback seems to disappear into a void. Three of the last four changes to the task view made my workflow slower, not faster, and I couldn't find anywhere to explain why.

I'm not writing to complain for the sake of it. I still think this is the best tool in its category, and I still pay for it happily. I'd just like to know whether there's a customer advisory group or a beta programme where long-time users can give feedback before changes ship. I'd gladly take part.

Best regards,
Anders Holm

subject: Positive feedback + quick question
body: Loving the product so far, the team adopted it in days. Quick question: can guests comment on tasks, or only view? We'd like clients to leave feedback directly on designs.
Your chatbot is useless. It keeps sending me help articles that have nothing to do with my question. I just want a human.

subject: Mobile app feedback
body: General feedback on the mobile app: it's fine for checking tasks, but creating anything is a pain. Too many taps to add a due date and an assignee. Compared to the web app, it feels like an afterthought. No specific bug, just the overall experience.

subject: Stored XSS in task descriptions
body:
Hello security team,

I'm an independent security researcher and I'd like to report what I believe is a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in your web application.

When a task description is edited through the rich-text editor and contains a specially crafted link with a javascript: URL inside an HTML entity-encoded attribute, the sanitiser doesn't neutralise it. When another user opens the task and hovers over the link, the script runs in their session. In my testing, using two accounts I own in a workspace I created, I was able to read the victim's session-bound API responses.

I have not accessed any data belonging to other customers, and I've kept the proof of concept strictly within my own test workspace. I'm happy to share full reproduction steps and the payload through a secure channel. Could you let me know the right contact and whether you run a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programme? I'll hold off on any public disclosure until you've had a reasonable time to fix it.

Regards,
Nikhil Varma
Found an IDOR: changing the task ID in /api/v2/tasks/{id}/attachments lets me download attachments from tasks in other workspaces. Where do I report this privately?

subject: Security vulnerability report
body: Your password reset endpoint doesn't rate-limit requests, and the response differs depending on whether the email exists, so it allows account enumeration. I discovered this while testing our own integration. Do you have a security.txt or a disclosure email?

subject: Bug bounty?
body: Do you run a bug bounty programme? I found a couple of potential issues in your OAuth flow (open redirect in the redirect_uri validation) and want to report them through the proper channel.
Your login page is missing the X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors headers, so it can be embedded in an iframe (clickjacking). Low severity but thought you should know.

subject: Sensitive data in URL
body: Hi, I noticed that when sharing a public link to a board, the URL includes what looks like a long-lived access token as a query parameter. Those URLs end up in browser history, proxy logs, and referrer headers. That seems like a security risk. Should I report this somewhere else?

subject: Possible vulnerability in file uploads
body: Uploading an SVG with embedded JavaScript as a task attachment, then opening the attachment's direct link, runs the script on your main domain. I've only tested this in my own workspace. Can someone from security contact me? I'd rather not post details here.
Your API returns full stack traces with internal hostnames and library versions on 500 errors. Might want to turn that off in production. Example: request req_ee41b0a2.

subject: Responsible disclosure: session fixation
body: I'd like to responsibly disclose a session fixation issue: the session cookie isn't rotated after login, so an attacker who can set a cookie before login can hijack the session afterwards. Please send me a PGP key or secure channel for full details.

subject: Security issue + question about SOC 2
body: Two things from our security team: 1) we found that your invite links don't expire, even after the invite is accepted, so anyone with an old link could join. We think that's a vulnerability. 2) Could you send us your latest SOC 2 Type II report? We need it for our annual vendor review.
CSRF on the /settings/email endpoint, no token required. I can change a logged-in user's email via a malicious page. Reporting privately, please advise.

subject: Leaked credentials on a public repo
body: While scanning GitHub I found what looks like one of your internal API keys in a public repository belonging to someone who appears to be your employee (the repo is named ourapp-internal-scripts). I haven't used the key. Let me know where to send the link so you can revoke it.

subject: Subdomain takeover
body: The subdomain status-old.ourapp.com has a CNAME pointing to an unclaimed Heroku app, so anyone could take it over and host content on your domain. I haven't claimed it. Might want to remove the DNS record.

Hi, I'm a student learning web security. I think your comment field might be vulnerable to HTML injection (I could make text appear red using a font tag). Not sure if that counts. Should I report this somewhere?

subject: Report: privilege escalation for guests
body: Guests can escalate themselves to members by replaying a role-change request from a member session with their own session cookie. The server doesn't check that the requester is an admin. Verified within my own test workspace only. Please contact me for details. This seems serious.

subject: Hacked account
body: Someone got into my account. They changed my name to "lol" and deleted two of my projects. I've changed my password but I'm scared they still have access. Please help me secure it and get my projects back. My email is carlos.rivas@protonmail.com
I got a login alert from Russia 10 min ago. Wasn't me. What do I do

subject: Suspicious activity in our workspace
body:
Hello,

Our admin noticed this morning that a user account belonging to one of our project managers, who's currently on leave, was active overnight between 01:00 and 04:00 our time. In that window the account exported three projects to CSV, invited two external email addresses as guests, and changed the notification settings for several shared projects so updates would go to one of those external addresses.

We've suspended the user and removed the guests, but we need your help to understand the full scope. Specifically: can you give us the IP addresses and user agents for that session, confirm whether any API tokens were created, and tell us whether any other accounts in our workspace show similar activity? We'll need to report this internally and possibly to a regulator, so a detailed timeline would be very helpful.

Our org ID is 40718 and the affected user is l.moreau@altamed-group.fr.

Thank you,
Sébastien Garnier
IT Security Officer, Altamed Group

subject: Phishing email pretending to be you
body: Several of our staff received an email that looks exactly like your password reset email, but the link goes to ourapp-login-secure.com. Two people entered their passwords before we noticed. We've reset their passwords. Can you check whether anyone logged into their accounts after the phishing email arrived? Workspace: fairhaven-clinic.ourapp.com
Someone added a new admin to our workspace that none of us know. How did they get in?? Remove them please, org 88213

subject: Unknown device logged in
body: My account security page shows an active session from a Windows PC in Vietnam. I only use a Mac and an iPhone. I've clicked "log out all sessions". Is that enough, or could they still have access? Should I be worried about my data?

subject: Account compromised + 2FA
body: I think my account was accessed by someone else (tasks were edited that I didn't touch). I'd also like to turn on two-factor, which I clearly should have done ages ago. How do I do that, and can you tell me when and from where the other logins happened? Account acct_6gw1pq.
My email address on the account was changed to one I don't recognise, and now I can't log in because the reset goes to that address. Help! My original email was tanvi.rao@gmail.com

subject: Ex-employee still accessing
body: We removed a former employee from the workspace three weeks ago, but our activity log shows her account viewing tasks yesterday. How is that possible? Please investigate. We're worried she's taking client information to her new employer. Workspace ID ws_41280.

subject: API tokens created without permission
body: Our audit log shows two personal access tokens created on our admin account on Saturday. The admin says he didn't create them. Can you revoke all tokens on that account and tell us whether they were used? Org ID 61193.
Password changed without me doing it. Got an email saying "your password was changed". I didn't. What now? Username amelia.stone

subject: Strange tasks appearing
body: Tasks with Russian text and links to crypto sites keep appearing in our projects, created by one of our team members' accounts. He says he didn't create them. We think his account was hacked. How do we lock it down and find out how they got in?

subject: Possibly compromised + want to cancel
body: Hi, I noticed logins to my account from places I've never been, so I think it was hacked. I've changed my password. Honestly this has put me off, and I'd like to cancel my subscription too once you've confirmed my account is secure. Email: j.whitaker@bellsouth.net
someone is logged in as me right now, i can see my cursor moving on the board. what do i do

subject: Hacked, need logs for police report
body: My business account was hacked and client contracts were downloaded. I'm filing a police report and need the access logs showing the unauthorised logins (IP addresses, times). How can I get these? Account email: m.baptiste@baptiste-avocats.fr

subject: GDPR data request
body: Under Article 15 of the GDPR, I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me, including account data, usage logs and any data shared with third parties. My account email is kasper.nielsen@post.dk. Please respond within the statutory one month.
Do you have a signed DPA we can use? Our legal team needs it before we can put customer data in the app.

subject: Data residency
body: We're a German healthcare provider. Can you confirm where our data is stored and processed, and whether you can guarantee EU-only data residency including backups and support access? This is a hard requirement from our data protection officer before we can expand usage from 20 to 300 users.

subject: CCPA deletion request
body: I am a California resident and I request that you delete all personal information you have collected about me under the CCPA. My email is ryan.cho@gmail.com. Please confirm when it's done.
Can you send your SOC 2 Type II report and your latest pen test summary? Vendor review due Friday.

subject: Security questionnaire
body:
Dear team,

We're in the final stages of selecting a project management platform for our group of companies (about 1,200 employees across five countries), and your product is on the shortlist. Before we can sign, our information security team needs to complete a vendor risk assessment.

We'd be grateful if you could provide the following:

1. A completed copy of our security questionnaire (about 140 questions, based on the SIG Lite framework). Please tell us where to send it.
2. Your current SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 certificate.
3. Your data processing agreement, including a list of sub-processors.
4. Details of your data retention and deletion practices, particularly what happens to customer data after contract termination.
5. Information on data residency options for EU and UK entities.

Our target signing date is the end of next month, so we'd appreciate receiving these within two weeks if possible.

Kind regards,
Helena Voss
Head of Procurement, Arvenia Group

subject: Sub-processor list
body: Where can I find your current list of sub-processors? We need to review it under our DPA. Also, will we be notified when new sub-processors are added?
Please confirm whether you use customer data to train AI models. Our compliance team needs a written statement.

subject: Employee data request
body: One of our employees has made a data subject access request to us, and some of her data is in your system (tasks, comments, time entries in our workspace). As the controller, we need you, as processor, to help us extract all of her personal data. How do we do that? Her email is anna.kovacs@brightstone.hu, our workspace ID is ws_77402.

subject: HIPAA BAA
body: Do you sign a Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA? We're a small therapy practice and want to use the app for scheduling, but we can't store any patient info without a BAA.
Right to be forgotten request. Delete all my data. GDPR Art. 17. Email: lucia.ferraro@libero.it

subject: Data retention after cancellation
body: If we cancel, how long do you keep our data? Our retention policy requires that all vendor copies are deleted within 30 days of contract end, with written confirmation. Can you commit to that?

subject: Compliance docs + upgrade
body: We need your ISO 27001 certificate and DPA for our compliance file. Once legal signs off, we'd like to upgrade from Pro to Business for 45 seats. Can you send the docs, and can the sales team send a quote for the upgrade at the same time? Org ID 90621.
We're subject to the Swiss FADP. Do you have a Swiss addendum to your DPA, or a transfer impact assessment for Switzerland?

subject: Cookie consent
body: Our website embeds your public board view for clients. Our cookie scanner flags several tracking cookies from your domain on that embed. Are those strictly necessary? We need to know for our cookie banner and GDPR compliance.

subject: Audit log retention for compliance
body: For our SOX audit we need to keep audit logs of who changed what for 7 years. How long do you keep audit logs, and can we export them regularly for our own archive? We're on Enterprise, org 13370.
Is your service FedRAMP authorised? We're a US government contractor and it's a requirement.

subject: Deletion confirmation for GDPR
body: Three weeks ago I asked for all my personal data to be deleted under GDPR (ticket #58812) and got an automated reply, but no confirmation since. The legal deadline is one month. Please confirm the deletion is complete, in writing.

subject: Feedback about security team response
body: I reported a vulnerability to security@ three weeks ago and haven't received any acknowledgement. That's not great for a company that stores this much sensitive data. Could someone at least confirm receipt? The issue concerned public link tokens not expiring.
Love the product, but please make it easier to find the security settings. Took me 10 minutes to find where to turn on 2FA. Also can you confirm 2FA is supported with hardware keys?

subject: Positive feedback and seat question
body: Our team is really enjoying the product. Adoption has been much easier than with our last tool. Everyone from design to finance is using it daily. One practical question: we're growing and need 5 more seats. Can we add them mid-cycle?

subject: Complaint about account manager
body: Our account manager has changed three times this year and each new one asks us the same onboarding questions. We're an Enterprise customer paying a lot and it feels like nobody knows our account. This is feedback, not a request, but I hope someone takes it seriously.
The product feels slower and clunkier every year. I've used it since 2020. I miss the old version.

subject: Vulnerability: stored XSS in project names
body: Project names aren't escaped in the "Move to project" dropdown, so a project named runs script for anyone who opens that dropdown. Tested in my own workspace. Please fix; details available on request.

subject: Security disclosure + bounty question
body: I found an authentication bypass in the mobile API (you can call some endpoints with an expired token). Before I share details: do you pay bounties, and what's your disclosure timeline? I'd like to give you 90 days before publishing.
We got an email saying someone logged into our admin account from a new device and approved it, but nobody did. Our admin's 2FA is on. How was this possible? acct_adm771

subject: Compromised account, urgent
body: My account was hacked and the attacker is sending messages to my clients through task comments asking them to pay invoices into a new bank account. I've changed my password but I can't see how they're still getting in. PLEASE freeze my account until we figure this out. Email: d.kowalski@kowalski-builders.pl

subject: DPIA support
body: Our DPO is running a data protection impact assessment on our use of your platform for HR onboarding. Could you provide information on encryption at rest and in transit, access controls for your staff, and your breach notification process? A standard security whitepaper would be fine.
Do you keep IP addresses of users? For how long? Asking for our privacy notice.

subject: Data processing location + SSO question
body: Our legal team needs confirmation that our data stays in the EU, in writing, for our records. Also, our IT team wants to know if SSO with Azure AD is available on the Business plan or only on Enterprise.

subject: Great product, one gripe
body: Really solid product overall, and I've recommended it to three other founders. My one gripe is that the monthly price for small teams is high compared to competitors. I'd happily pay annually if there were a bigger discount. Anyway, keep it up.
Your status page said everything was fine during yesterday's 2-hour outage. That's not OK. We rely on it to decide whether to escalate. Please make it honest.

subject: Feedback on price increase + cancel
body: The price increase you announced is too steep for us, and honestly the product hasn't improved enough to justify it. Please cancel our subscription at the end of the current term. Account acct_pz0192. Thanks for the years of service though.

subject: Reporting a vulnerability in your Chrome extension
body: Your Chrome extension requests access to all websites and injects a script into every page, even though it only needs to work on your own domain. It also sends the current page URL to your servers on every tab change. That's a privacy and security concern for our users. Please look into it.
I think someone accessed my account through a shared computer at the library, I forgot to log out. Can you log me out everywhere? isaac.m@gmail.com

subject: Hacked account + billing
body: My account was hacked last week and the hacker upgraded it to the Enterprise plan, which charged $900 to my card. I've already regained access and changed my password. Please refund the $900 and downgrade me back to Pro. Account acct_hx9v02.

subject: Privacy request for a deceased user
body: My late mother had an account with you. Under data protection law, as her executor, I'd like a copy of her data and then its deletion. I can provide the death certificate and proof of executorship. Her email was ruth.abernathy@btinternet.com.
Please send us your data processing agreement and confirm the governing law. Also, we'd like to add a clause about 72-hour breach notification. Who in your legal team can we talk to?

subject: Great support experience
body: Just a note to say that Leila on your billing team was incredibly helpful sorting out our invoice mess last week. She was patient, clear and fast. Please let her manager know.

subject: Security bug + product feedback
body: Reporting a security issue: the "public link" option on attachments generates predictable, sequential URLs, so anyone can guess other files' links. Also, some general feedback: it would be better if public links were off by default for new workspaces. Our team didn't realise they were on.
The new AI assistant keeps suggesting things that are wrong, like assigning tasks to people who've left. It's more annoying than helpful. Can I turn it off? If not, please treat this as feedback.

subject: Our account was breached
body: Our security monitoring flagged an unusual login to our admin account from a known malicious IP, followed by bulk exports. We've disabled the account. We need you to (1) preserve all logs for that account from the last 30 days, (2) revoke all sessions and API tokens across our workspace, and (3) contact us urgently to coordinate. Org ID 20488, contact: soc@meridian-bank.com. This is a priority 1 incident for us.

subject: Data export for GDPR portability
body: I'd like to exercise my right to data portability under GDPR Article 20. Please provide all my personal data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON or CSV). Account email: h.muller@web.de
The product is good but the support chat closes before I finish typing my question. Happened 3 times. Frustrating.

subject: Leaked in data breach?
body: I got an alert from Have I Been Pwned that my email appeared in a breach mentioning your company. Was there a breach? Should I change my password? What data was exposed? My email is v.petrova@yandex.ru

subject: Accessibility statement
body: Do you have a VPAT or accessibility conformance report? We're a public university and can only buy software that meets WCAG 2.1 AA. Also, can you share your privacy policy for student data (FERPA)?
Admin here. We need to know every IP address that accessed our workspace in the last 90 days, for a compliance audit. Can you provide that? Org ID 71002.

subject: Vulnerability report: rate limiting on 2FA
body: The 2FA verification endpoint doesn't appear to rate-limit attempts. I was able to submit several hundred codes in a minute from a single IP on my own test account without being locked out. That would make brute-forcing a 6-digit code feasible. Happy to share my test script with your security team.

subject: Feedback: love it, but...
body: We absolutely love the product, but please stop sending us marketing emails about features we already use. We get three a week. Otherwise perfect.
My kid used my laptop and I think she changed some settings and deleted stuff in my account. Nothing malicious, just a kid, but can I see an activity history of what was changed yesterday?
